title: Dr. Ariel Ostad Treats the Glabellar Lines Using Jeuveau
caption:
Dr. Ariel Ostad assesses a patient for Jeuveau treatment of the glabellar lines, the vertical frown lines between the eyebrows. He evaluates muscle strength, facial anatomy, and expression to guide precise placement for a softer, natural-looking result.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Visit our official website –

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
transcript: Before I perform any injectable treatment, I always begin with an assessment. Even when we're treating an area as specific as the frown lines between the eyebrows, every patient has a slightly different anatomy, pattern, a movement, and a degree of muscle activity. Today, we're going to be treating the glabella lines with Juvo. Juvo is the botulinum toxin type A injectable, indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe glabella lines in adults. Before I treat you, I want to see exactly how your muscles are functioning. So can you please relax your face for me? First, I look at the face completely at rest. I'm looking at the lines that are already visible, the position of the brows, and whether there's any natural asymmetry from one side to the other. So now frown for me as strongly as you can. Good. When she frowns, we can see the activity of the muscles that are responsible for creating these lines, primarily what we call the corrugator muscles located on either side and the procerus muscle centrally. So relax again and frown one more time. What I'm assessing here isn't simply the line itself. I'm looking at the underlying muscle activity that's creating that line, where the muscles are positioned, how strongly they're contracting, and whether that movement is really symmetrical. It's important because I don't approach every patient exactly the same way. With Juvo, the goal is to temporarily reduce the muscle activity responsible for the moderate to severe glabella lines and therefore improve their appearance. For me, a thoughtful treatment begins with understanding the individual patient's anatomy rather than simply looking at a wrinkle and treating it. One more frown for me, perfect. Now that I've seen how your muscles behave both at rest and with movement, I can plan the treatment appropriately. The injection itself may only take a few minutes, but the assessment beforehand is really what allows us to approach the treatment with precision. Juvo temporarily improves the look of moderate to severe frown lines between the eyebrows and adults. There are risks of treatment. Effects of Juvo may spread hours to weeks after injection, causing serious symptoms. Alert your doctor right away of difficulty swallowing, speaking, breathing, eye problems, or muscle weakness, which can be signs of a life-threatening condition. If this happens, do not drive a car, operate machinery, or do other dangerous activities. For complete safety information, see at Juvo Way of a List PI or visit evillisrx.com. Ask your doctor if Juvo is right for you.

creator: prof.firasalniaimi
caption:
Exosomes are extracellular vesicles, tiny nano-sized particles naturally secreted by cells, that act as biological messengers. They carry proteins, growth factors, and genetic material between cells, playing a critical role in cell-to-cell communication, tissue repair, and regeneration. In dermatology, harnessing the power of exosomes means we can now stimulate the skin’s own healing mechanisms at a cellular level, without the need for invasive procedures.

We are still in the early stages of ou
transcript: So many patients ask me about exosomes. So what are exosomes? We, in medical terms, call them nano-sized vesicles. So these are very small particles that carry growth factors, proteins, which are essentially messengers that try and communicate between the cells, ultimately sending the message for the cells to function better in terms of making more collagen and promoting wound dealing. So when can you use exosomes? Well, personally, I find that exosomes are helpful after certain procedures, such as laser treatments or micro-needling. We're not there yet understanding the full science and the full spectrum of applications of exosomes. So we're very much at the first stage of understanding what exosomes are.
